description: A director of experiential learning must approve a student's summer internship at an elementary learning center and finalize its academic-credit, training, funding, and start requirements, with input from an academic advisor, an employer liaison, and a financial-aid specialist.

shared_context.S1: A student has applied for a summer internship at Northstar Learning Center, an elementary education site.
shared_context.S2: The draft application lists an unpaid placement beginning June 2 and one elective academic credit.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Ellis makes the final approval and records the internship terms in the experiential-learning system.
shared_context.S4: The college's routine pre-approval meeting asks the academic advisor, employer liaison, and financial-aid specialist to review the application before it is finalized.

PF1.text: Ms. Shah's completed degree audit shows that the student must register the internship for exactly 3 academic credits to satisfy the education-program capstone requirement; she completed the audit this week, but the result has not yet been entered in the experiential-learning system.

PF2.text: Northstar's current host handbook requires every intern to complete mandated-reporter training before any contact with children; Mr. Brooks confirmed this requirement with the site's coordinator this week, but the requirement is not on the college's draft application.

PF3.text: The student's approved summer aid package includes a $2,000 grant that is retained only if the internship is registered by May 15 and no employer stipend is accepted; Ms. Garcia verified these conditions in the aid award record this week, but they are not shown on the application.

acceptance_conditions: The internship must be registered for exactly 3 academic credits.
The training must be completed before the student has contact with children.
The registration deadline must be May 15.
The $2,000 summer grant must be retained.
An employer-training verification commitment must be recorded.
No employer stipend may be accepted.
A financial-aid compliance commitment must be recorded.

decisive_facts.why: The degree audit changes the internship registration from the draft's 1 credit to exactly 3 credits.
The host handbook changes the plan from no listed training condition to mandated-reporter training completed before child contact, with an employer-training verification commitment.
The aid award record changes the registration deadline to May 15, changes grant status to retained, forbids accepting a stipend, and requires a financial-aid compliance commitment.
